key: ADRIENN: You're early.
en: ADRIENN: You're early.
ja: アドリエンヌ: 早いね。

key: TAKA: Not early enough, apparently.
en: TAKA: Not early enough, apparently.
ja: タカ: どうやら早すぎたわけじゃなかったみたいで。

key: I was hoping not to keep you waiting.
en: I was hoping not to keep you waiting.
ja: お待たせしたくなかったんですが。

key: ADRIENN: I had other business.
en: ADRIENN: I had other business.
ja: アドリエンヌ: 別の用事があってね。

key: ADRIENN: Adrienn Flores.
en: ADRIENN: Adrienn Flores.
ja: アドリエンヌ: アドリエンヌ・フローレス。

key: Despite my best efforts, I've done a woefully incomplete job of meeting each of the members of my community since this reconstruction got underway.
en: Despite my best efforts, I've done a woefully incomplete job of meeting each of the members of my community since this reconstruction got underway.
ja: 最善を尽くしてきたつもりだけど、この復興が始まって以来、コミュニティの一人一人に会うという点では、お粗末な仕事しかできていないわ。

key: I've seen you in the Nightclub, but missed the chance to make your acquaintance properly.
en: I've seen you in the Nightclub, but missed the chance to make your acquaintance properly.
ja: ナイトクラブであなたを見かけたことはあったけど、きちんと知り合う機会を逃していたわね。

key: Nevertheless, I understand you've been a good friend to \PN.
en: Nevertheless, I understand you've been a good friend to \PN.
ja: とはいえ、あなたが\PNの良き友人だと聞いているわ。

key: Thank you for that.
en: Thank you for that.
ja: そのことには感謝しているの。

key: TAKA: I've missed too many opportunities for that and many other things myself.
en: TAKA: I've missed too many opportunities for that and many other things myself.
ja: タカ: 僕も、それを含めて多くの機会を逃してきましたから。

key: Don't worry about it on my behalf.
en: Don't worry about it on my behalf.
ja: 僕のことは気にしないでください。

key: But I'm glad \PN could introduce us now.
en: But I'm glad \PN could introduce us now.
ja: でも、\PNが今こうして引き合わせてくれてうれしいです。

key: Did you already hear my proposal?
en: Did you already hear my proposal?
ja: 僕の提案はもう聞きましたか?

key: ADRIENN: Not the details.
en: ADRIENN: Not the details.
ja: アドリエンヌ: 詳しくはまだよ。

key: ADRIENN: A cultural center, was it?
en: ADRIENN: A cultural center, was it?
ja: アドリエンヌ: 文化センター、だったかしら?

key: TAKA: That's right.
en: TAKA: That's right.
ja: タカ: そうです。

key: My father felt quite strongly about preserving the history and origin of the region.
en: My father felt quite strongly about preserving the history and origin of the region.
ja: 父はこの地方の歴史と起源を守ることに、強い思いを持っていました。

key: He was prepared to fight until his last breath for it-- and he most certainly did.
en: He was prepared to fight until his last breath for it-- and he most certainly did.
ja: そのためなら息絶えるまで戦うつもりでいて――実際、その通りになりました。

key: I still have quite a few feelings about not having been able to do more to stop that, but...
en: I still have quite a few feelings about not having been able to do more to stop that, but...
ja: それを止められなかったことについては、今でもいろいろな思いがありますが……

key: I realize now that he had the wrong idea from the outset.
en: I realize now that he had the wrong idea from the outset.
ja: 今は、父が最初から間違った考えを持っていたんだと気づいています。

key: Instead of struggling against progress, we should be guiding the people and teaching them how to grow and respect everyone on this land.
en: Instead of struggling against progress, we should be guiding the people and teaching them how to grow and respect everyone on this land.
ja: 進歩に抗うのではなく、僕たちは人々を導き、この土地にいる誰もを尊重しながら成長する方法を教えていくべきなんです。

key: ADRIENN: Well, I have to say, I certainly much prefer your approach to your father's.
en: ADRIENN: Well, I have to say, I certainly much prefer your approach to your father's.
ja: アドリエンヌ: そうね、正直、あなたのやり方のほうがお父様のやり方よりずっと好きだわ。

key: TAKA: I'm starting to see how he was as much a hurt child as anyone else.
en: TAKA: I'm starting to see how he was as much a hurt child as anyone else.
ja: タカ: 父も、傷ついた子供の一人にすぎなかったんだと、最近わかってきました。

key: Elias has told me a lot about my grandfather recently.
en: Elias has told me a lot about my grandfather recently.
ja: 最近、イライアスが祖父についていろいろ話してくれたんです。

key: He said that to lead is to walk with kindness and strength, hand in hand.
en: He said that to lead is to walk with kindness and strength, hand in hand.
ja: 導くということは、優しさと強さを手を取り合わせて歩むことだと、彼は言っていました。

key: I think this is what our family was always supposed to do.
en: I think this is what our family was always supposed to do.
ja: それが、僕たちの家系がずっとすべきことだったんだと思います。

key: My father just got too caught up in his own pain, and lost the plot for it.
en: My father just got too caught up in his own pain, and lost the plot for it.
ja: 父はただ、自分の痛みに囚われすぎて、それを見失っていたんです。

key: It's my responsibility to set us on the right path again.
en: It's my responsibility to set us on the right path again.
ja: 再び正しい道に戻すのは、僕の責任です。

key: ADRIENN: Well, aside from the family legacy aspect, I'd say that's basically most of my opinions on the matter in a nutshell.
en: ADRIENN: Well, aside from the family legacy aspect, I'd say that's basically most of my opinions on the matter in a nutshell.
ja: アドリエンヌ: そうね、家系の話を抜きにすれば、それがだいたい、わたしのこの件に対する意見をまとめたようなものだわ。

key: Kindness and strength, hand in hand...
en: Kindness and strength, hand in hand...
ja: 優しさと強さを、手を取り合わせて……

key: ADRIENN: I'd like to make that motto the core of this cultural center of yours.
en: ADRIENN: I'd like to make that motto the core of this cultural center of yours.
ja: アドリエンヌ: その理念を、あなたの文化センターの中心に据えたいわ。

key: TAKA: Oh, so...
en: TAKA: Oh, so...
ja: タカ: ああ、それじゃ……

key: You would approve it, then?
en: You would approve it, then?
ja: 承認してもらえるということですか?

key: ADRIENN: If there were any doubt about that before, there isn't now.
en: ADRIENN: If there were any doubt about that before, there isn't now.
ja: アドリエンヌ: 前に迷いがあったとしても、今はもうないわ。

key: We're getting some deals going in other regions that can probably sustain the costs.
en: We're getting some deals going in other regions that can probably sustain the costs.
ja: 他の地方でいくつか話を進めていて、費用はおそらくそれで賄えるはずよ。

key: The only concern is the space...
en: The only concern is the space...
ja: 気がかりなのは場所だけね……

key: TAKA: I don't think that'll be an issue.
en: TAKA: I don't think that'll be an issue.
ja: タカ: それは問題ないと思います。

key: Actually, that's why I asked to meet you here.
en: Actually, that's why I asked to meet you here.
ja: 実は、だからここで会いたいとお願いしたんです。

key: ADRIENN: ...Here?
en: ADRIENN: ...Here?
ja: アドリエンヌ: ……ここで?

key: TAKA: I'm sure you know what the Grand Stairway is above.
en: TAKA: I'm sure you know what the Grand Stairway is above.
ja: タカ: 上にある大階段のことはご存じですよね。

key: I think we can build up from there.
en: I think we can build up from there.
ja: そこから上に建て増しできると思うんです。

key: This and the Grand Gate take up a needlessly large space.
en: This and the Grand Gate take up a needlessly large space.
ja: ここと大門は、無駄に広いスペースを取っていますから。

key: The lower floors can be for preservation of the ruin, the middle can be an open terrace traffic-way for access to Route 1,
en: The lower floors can be for preservation of the ruin, the middle can be an open terrace traffic-way for access to Route 1,
ja: 下の階は遺跡の保存に、中間階は1番道路へ通じる開放的なテラス通路にできます。

key: And community facilities for recreation and education can be in the upper floors.
en: And community facilities for recreation and education can be in the upper floors.
ja: そして上の階には、娯楽と教育のための地域施設を置けます。

key: ADRIENN: It sounds like you've gotten quite the jump on this.
en: ADRIENN: It sounds like you've gotten quite the jump on this.
ja: アドリエンヌ: ずいぶん先まで考えてあるみたいね。

key: ...And what would you say if I offered you a position leading and directly managing its development?
en: ...And what would you say if I offered you a position leading and directly managing its development?
ja: ……その開発を率いて、直接運営する立場をあなたに任せると言ったら、どう答える?

key: TAKA: I'd say that would be very kind of you.
en: TAKA: I'd say that would be very kind of you.
ja: タカ: それはとても、ありがたいお話だと言います。

key: ADRIENN: One's kindness; another's strength.
en: ADRIENN: One's kindness; another's strength.
ja: アドリエンヌ: 片方が優しさ、もう片方が強さ、というわけね。
